svg.title: Learning Was More Than a School Building
svg.desc: Earlier learning: Families and communities transmitted knowledge before colonial schools.. Different settings: Practice with guidance and organized classes are different learning settings.. Evidence needed: A building alone does not establish attendance or the teaching that occurred.
